messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: SmartRouting detected oscillating fallback between eu-west and us-central for model family rwd-13B. Error rate spike: tool-call failures 7.2% -> 18.9% over 3m. Thread start 1758802468
sarah-d: paging SRE oncall, I'm seeing customers reporting malformed tool calls and 504s, looks correlated with regional fallbacks
mike-ops: on it, grabbing logs + routing traces
raj: I'm the oncall, taking this. handoff :wave:
raj: initial observation: smart-routing decision tree keeps flipping because availability score for rwd-13B-quant_EU is briefly high then failing; fallback chooses rwd-13B-fp16_US which doesn't support tool_call v2 -> toolcall errors
sarah-d: that matches support matrix; quant variant lacks tool_call hook in our runtime (known limitation)
tess-sre: can we throttle reroutes? we have circuit-breaker but it's per-region not per-variant
raj: temporary mitigation: disable cross-region fallback for rwd-13B family and force region-affinity for active customer sessions
raj: running command:
```
infractl routing update-policy --model-family rwd-13B --allow-cross-region=false --rollout=immediate
```
raj: applying now
incident-bot: deploy-bot: policy update started by raj at 1758802523
mike-ops: adding A/B rule to pin customers currently on quant variants to same region to avoid mid-request swap
raj: also scaling up eu-west quant pool to reduce availability oscillation
sarah-d: customer impact: 12 enterprise tenants showing >5% request errors, mostly tool_call JSON parse errors. Raising priority and notifying CSMs
eng-lead-ana: heads up, this will affect latency for some US customers if we force geo-affinity
eva-ml: filed an issue to add tool_call compatibility flag to compatibility matrix; current data missing per-quant build support
raj: logs snippet:
```
[1758802499] route_decision: candidate: rwd-13B-quant_EU avail=0.82 -> accept
[1758802501] model_error: toolcall not_supported
[1758802503] route_decision: fallback to rwd-13B-fp16_US avail=0.9
[1758802504] model_error: toolcall mismatch schema
```
mike-ops: after policy update, fallback attempts dropped from 12/m to 1/m. errors reduced to 3.1%
sarah-d: CSMs updated, opened incident ticket INC-2025-331, emailed affected customers with workaround (retry 5s)
raj: still seeing a small number of oscillations for beta workloads due to TTL mismatch in decision cache
tess-sre: set cache TTL to 30s for route decisions for rwd-13B family
```
infractl config set smart_routing.cache_ttl --model-family rwd-13B --ttl=30s
```
incident-bot: config change applied by tess-sre at 1758802830
raj: handoff to night oncall @nina. I'm leaving notes in the playbook and will follow up in morning. main mitigations: disabled cross-region fallback for rwd-13B, scaled eu-west quant pool, lowered cache TTL, pinned active sessions
nina: thanks, taking over :raised_hands:
nina: next steps: schedule hotfix to compatibility matrix to mark quant variants as tool-call unsupported to prevent smart-routing mismatches; coordinate with runtime team for toolcall shim
eng-runtime-lead: logged task RUNTIME-442 to add graceful shim for quant variants; ETA 48h
sarah-d: postmortem owner assigned: raj
sarah-d: severity: SEV2, customer-facing impact but mitigated
raj: will follow up with full incident timeline, RCA, and remediation plan. closing thread for now, will reopen if errors >2% again
incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-331 acknowledged. Thread closed at 1758803840
